ir.name: loss_regret_gap_exp_contrast_weighted_fixed
ir.intuition: Contrastive loss weighted by exponential regret gaps using stable tensor ops and safe negation.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
weight = batch['weight']
margin = lpw - lpl
hinge = relu(1 - margin)
exp_term = exp(-beta * delta_regret)
contrast = exp_term * hinge
weighted_contrast = contrast * weight
loss = log(sum(weighted_contrast) + eps)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', 5.0))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(margin), margin))
    neg_beta_delta = ops.mul(ops.neg(ops.clamp(delta_regret, min=eps)), beta)
    exp_term = ops.exp(neg_beta_delta)
    contrast = ops.mul(exp_term, hinge)
    weighted_contrast = ops.mul(contrast, weight)
    safe_sum = ops.sum(weighted_contrast)
    loss = ops.log(ops.add(safe_sum, eps))
    return loss
